mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a sudden discounting effect on equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns during high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns during labor weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, increasing equity risk premia and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during labor strengthening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% month-over-month increase in retail sales (HOUST) signals healthy consumer demand, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates softening supply conditions, reducing market tightness and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in supply-side softening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, increasing equity risk premia and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during labor strengthening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% for three consecutive months indicates a weakening labor market, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns during labor weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
